When the case was called out, no one is present to press this petition.
Sri Santosh Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for the informant and learned AGA for the State respondents are present.

Sri Santosh Kumar Mishra, has filed a copy of the information slip informing the learned counsel for the petitioner that this case shall be taken up out of turn as the mediation has failed in this matter.
Information has been duly received but no one is present to press this petition.

sentences.text: The petitioners, by means of this writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, has invoked the jurisdiction of this Court with prayer to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 23.04.2022, registered as Case Crime No. 0254 of 2022, under Sections 323, 504, 506, 498A I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station-Cantt., District Gorakhpur for a direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioners in pursuance of impugned First Information Report.

Vide order dated 13.07.2022 the matter was referred to Mediation and Conciliation Centre,
Allahabad for settling the dispute amicably.
As per mediation report dated 02.12.2022 proceedings for mediation have taken place on several dates, however, no agreement has been made between the parties.
In this view of the matter, interim order, if any, stands vacated.
Petition stands dismissed for want of prosecution.
Information slip is taken on record.
